g.title: Parses CLI args, creates QApplication, builds Microscope, launches GUI
Main application window. Holds references to all controllers and widgets.
Central object built from machine_config.yaml. Owns all hardware references, controllers, and addons.
Manages live camera streaming. - Toggles trigger mode (SW / HW / continuous) - Synchronizes illumination on/off with exposure - Controls frame rate
Orchestrates multi-position acquisition: 1. Generate grid coordinates 2. Per FOV: move stage → autofocus → per channel: illuminate → acquire → save 3. Repeat for Z-stack, time-lapse
Software autofocus via defocus sweep. Scans N Z-planes, measures image sharpness, moves to best-focus position.
Hardware reflection-based autofocus. Monitors laser spot position shift on focus camera to infer Z displacement. Per-objective calibration.
Coordinates all light sources. Channels: set_intensity, turn_on/off. Devices: CoolLED, Andor Laser, LED matrix, IO-routed lasers.
Frame routing hub. Camera → on_new_frame() → display callback + save callback. Rate-limits display and save independently.
Tracks current objective, magnification, pixel size factor, tube lens focal length.
Per-channel brightness/contrast adjustment for display
Emits Qt signals with stage position after moves
Central routing table for all IO endpoints. Maps endpoint names → (controller, signal_type, channel). Configured from io_endpoints.yaml + machine_config.yaml.
Resolved endpoint: controller + channel. Calls set_digital / set_analog / send_trigger.
Routes to Teensy microcontroller. Channels: port:N (illumination), pin:N (TTL), trigger:N (camera), dac:N (analog out).
Routes to NI-DAQ hardware. AO channels for analog intensity, DO channels for TTL shutters.
Routes to serial light sources (CoolLED, LDI, Andor, etc.)

Central hardware coordinator. - Drives stepper motors (X/Y/Z/Theta/W) - 8-channel DAC for analog outputs - 16 illumination ports (multi-port firmware) - TTL outputs for shutters & triggers - Hardware trigger with illumination sync - Status packets every ~10ms
Stepper motors with configurable microstepping. Typical: 200 full-steps/rev, 2.54mm screw pitch. Limit switches for homing. Max ~30 mm/s, 500 mm/s² acceleration.

Acquisition camera. Supported SDKs: Daheng (GXiPy), Hamamatsu (DCAM), Tucsen, Andor (SDK3), IDS (Peak), FLIR, Photometrics. Trigger modes: software, hardware (LINE2), continuous. Pixel formats: MONO8/12/16, Bayer.
Detects reflected laser spot position. Spot centroid shift → Z displacement. Separate from main camera.
Sub-micron Z positioning for the objective. Controlled via DAC voltage (0–10V). Used for fast Z-stacking and focus tracking.
Multi-position wheel with bandpass filters. Selects emission wavelength for fluorescence.
Optical sectioning via spinning pinhole disk. Controls: disk motor, dichroic wheel, emission/excitation filters, iris diaphragm.
Combines multiple laser lines into a single fiber output. TTL-gated per line.
National Instruments data acquisition. AO: analog waveforms (100kHz sample rate). DO: digital TTL outputs. Used for high-speed synchronized illumination.
Programmable LED illumination patterns. Modes: brightfield, darkfield, DPC (phase contrast). RGB color mixing for multi-wavelength.
Switches between 2 objectives. Automatic Z-compensation on switch. Xeryon piezo motor, serial control.
Automated sample handling, media exchange, reagent delivery.

Single imaging channel definition: - camera_settings (exposure, gain, pixel_format) - illumination_settings (channel, intensity, LED mode) - filter_wheel, filter_position - z_offset_um - confocal_override (objective-specific)
User-facing imaging preset (objective-free): - channels: List[AcquisitionChannel] - confocal_mode, camera_live snapshot - emission_filter_positions - channel_groups for multi-camera
Per-run reproducibility record: - experiment_id, objective, pixel_size - selected channels, scan parameters - observation_state snapshot - Written to acquisition.yaml
Hardware illumination definition: - type: EPI or TRANSILLUMINATION - controller_port (D1-D8, USB1-USB8) - wavelength_nm - excitation filter wheel + position
Maps cameras to filter wheels and dichroic positions. Source-qualified references (confocal.1, standalone.Emission).
Runtime camera state: exposure, gain, ROI, binning, trigger mode, FPS
Multi-camera synchronization: SIMULTANEOUS or SEQUENTIAL with per-channel timing offsets
Loads and caches all YAML configuration. Manages user profiles and per-objective overrides. Merges general + objective channel configs at runtime.
Top-level hardware definition: devices (teensy, camera, stage, piezo, laser_af, nidaq), illumination_devices, objectives, IO endpoints, hardware bindings.
Channel name, color, illumination_channel, filter_wheel, z_offset, camera ID. Shared across all objectives.
Intensity, exposure, gain, pixel_format, confocal_override per channel. Merged with general.yaml at runtime.
Saved ObservationState snapshots. User can save/load presets from the GUI.
Hardware illumination definitions: channel names, ports, wavelengths, filter wheel associations.
IO endpoint definitions: trigger, intensity, shutter channels mapped to controllers + pins.
Queue-based async job processing. Job types: SaveImage, SaveOMETiff, SaveZarr, DownsampledView.
High-speed streaming: 1. Write raw bytes → frames.raw 2. Per-frame metadata → frame_metadata.jsonl 3. Post-capture decode → final format
OME-NGFF compliant Zarr output. 5D HCS: (T, C, Z, Y, X) per well. 6D non-HCS: (FOV, T, C, Z, Y, X). Blosc compression, async writes.
OME-TIFF stacks. Axes: TZCYX. Per-plane metadata. Compatible with ImageJ/FIJI.
Per-experiment metadata file: - manifest (experiment_id, objective, pixel size) - scan_parameters (grid, z-stack, time-lapse) - observation_states_used (full preset snapshots)

text.tspan: grid scan: ΔX, NX, ΔY, NY
